_comment: Effect claims: a rule bound to a probe that produces a number, and the baseline that number is judged against. Read by modules/rule_compiler/effect_harness.py. A claim nobody can run is UNMEASURED -- a verdict, not a blank.
_contract: probe is an argv list run without a shell from the repo root; pattern must capture the metric in group 1; direction is 'down' (lower is better) or 'up'. Baselines are measured numbers with a named source, never estimates.

effects.claim: Promoting a repeat finding to URGENT once and suppressing its routine notices reduces the number of files a reader must triage, without losing the finding.
effects.pattern: (\d+) files would have been written instead of \d+
effects.metric: handoff files a reader must triage
effects.note: baseline is the real corpus: 333 mirror-drift handoffs written between 2026-05-23 and 2026-07-29, all naming one pair, none escalated. The probe replays that corpus at its real cadence through the shipped policy.
